name: Potato Latkes with Smoked Salmon, Yogurt, Dill & Celery-Apple Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Place eggs, bread crumbs, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the egg mixture.
Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add dill to the bowl with the egg mixture (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel potatoes; using a box grater, coarsely grate, and place in a colander. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the potato as you can.
Add grated potato to the bowl with the egg mixture and use your hands to thoroughly combine the latke mixture.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a ⅓-cup measure, form the latke mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a baking sheet pan.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add patties and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove latkes to a paper towel-lined plate, placing additional paper towels between layers to soak up excess oil.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide latkes between plates and season with pepper; top with salmon, yogurt, and reserved dill. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
